channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iran clubs face Qatar and UAE sides at neutral venues in Champions League
item.description: Following the start of the US-Israel war on Iran, the first match of the Iranian league was played last week.

item.title: Why is Russia threatening UK with ‘consequences’ over Ukraine drones?
item.description: Russia is suffering attacks inside its own territory as long-range drones strike its strategic assets.

item.title: Yemeni government escalates attacks against Houthis: What’s next?
item.description: Fighting intensifies across Yemen as Houthis clash with internationally recognised government forces across many fronts.

item.title: Qatar: Iran’s claim that Doha is holding missing pilots is a ‘media ploy’
item.description: Qatar says Iran’s claim it is holding missing aircrew is untrue and a “media ploy”, with Tehran yet to verify it.

item.title: Qatar rejects Iran’s ‘false’ claims about missing pilots
item.description: Majed al-Ansari says the Iranian planes 'violated Qatar’s sovereignty' and were dealt with in accordance with the law.

item.title: Why has Trump threatened to bomb Oman – for a second time?
item.description: The US president threatened to bomb Oman over Hormuz, with US-Iran peace negotiations in a deadlock.

item.title: Putin’s ‘illusion of victory:’ Russia ramps up missile attacks on Ukraine
item.description: Deaths mount as Russia ramps up missile attacks on Ukraine, while Washington's promises of support remain elusive.

item.title: Syria, US say Israel attacks airbase in Idlib
item.description: Eight air strikes hit the Abu al-Duhur military base in Idlib's eastern countryside.

item.title: Student killed in Philippines Catholic school shooting
item.description: The alleged shooter, also a student, later took his own life.

item.title: Trump threatens to bomb US ally Oman if it 'gets in the way' over Iran deal
item.description: Trump's threat on Oman, which has been holding its own talks with Iran to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, comes as a 60-day window for peace negotiations expires.
